scope: six V12 best checkpoints; train-only DBB subclass references; CQ08 V3 validation scoring; test sealed
hypothesis: V12 subclass supervision may add train-only class-conditional DBB distance information beyond the aggregate Gate P(CU), while Clutter and Unknown create no known prototype.

score_contract.gate_energy: negative logsumexp of the two Gate logits
score_contract.nearest_subclass_cosine_distance: one minus maximum cosine similarity to a train-only DBB subclass center
score_contract.nearest_subclass_diagonal_mahalanobis: minimum square-root diagonal Mahalanobis distance to a train-only DBB subclass center; variance pooled from within-subclass train residuals

v13_design_evidence_gate.meaning: design-discussion evidence only; not a threshold, classifier, or deployment gate

interpretation_boundaries: This is a post-training representation diagnostic, not a trained or calibrated rejection mechanism.
No threshold or oracle operating point is computed or emitted.
Validation labels are used only to calculate diagnostic AUC and never enter centers or variance.
AUC measures ranking and does not prove the frozen precision/recall operating point is attainable.
The three seeds reuse the same 232 validation parents and are optimization replicates, not independent samples.
The evidence gate was frozen before running this diagnostic and only authorizes or rejects later design discussion.
Test, OOF, threshold fitting, new training, cascade/stable evaluation and P95 remain unexecuted.
